name: Sphinx
description: Sphinx is a Python documentation generator that builds HTML sites from reStructuredText or Markdown (through MyST-Parser) sources.
notes: Sphinx 9.1.0 with MyST-Parser 5.1.0 (Markdown) and a minimal custom theme (single page.html) instead of alabaster; search, genindex and source copies disabled. firstRelease from Sphinx 0.1 (2008-03-21).
